items.name: Kerosene / LOX
items.description: Refined kerosene burned with liquid oxygen (RP-1). Dense, cheap, and compact, which keeps tanks small and heavy for its energy.
items.source: Standard RP-1/LOX performance reference; cost is a gameplay approximation

items.name: Hydrogen / LOX
items.description: Liquid hydrogen burned with liquid oxygen. Highest efficiency of any chemical propellant, but it is extremely light, so tanks must be very large and heavy.
items.source: Standard LH2/LOX performance reference; tank factor approximated for gameplay

items.name: Methane / LOX
items.description: Liquid methane burned with liquid oxygen. A middle ground: cleaner burning and more efficient than kerosene, denser and cheaper to store than hydrogen.
items.source: Standard CH4/LOX performance reference; cost is a gameplay approximation

items.name: Hypergolic Storable
items.description: MMH fuel and NTO oxidizer ignite on contact with no ignition system. Storable for years and extremely reliable, but less efficient and more expensive per tonne.
items.source: Standard MMH/NTO performance reference; cost is a gameplay approximation
